title: JRC-ESTAT Census Population Grid 2021
selection: Cell centers inside a geodesic circle. Boundary cells retain their full original counts and 100 m footprints.
method: Modelled 100 m resident population counts, downscaled from Eurostat Census 2021 1 km grid. No resampling or smoothing.
citation: Pigaiani, Cristian; Freire, Sergio; Batista, Filipe (2024): JRC-ESTAT Census Population Grid 2021. European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC).
